lesson_title: Seven Questions, Full Marks: The Physics Paper Practice Run
hook_text: Wrong final answer... and still most of the marks? The memo pays per line, and most learners never learn the price list.
clip_script: Then Newton's second law: acceleration equals 30,8 divided by 8 — 3,85 metres per second squared, directed up the slope. Formula, one mark; substitution, one mark; answer with unit and direction, one mark. The audit before moving on: the answer is positive in the chosen direction and smaller than the frictionless value would be — sensible. Read, plan, execute, audit, move on.
visual_style: A solution building line by line with a coin dropping onto each line as its mark is paid; a final magnifying-glass sweep as the audit ticks the answer.
mood: Heist-planning energy — the paper's price list decoded line by line.
pacing: Steady line-by-line build with a percussive coin-drop per mark, quick audit flourish to close.
call_to_action: Walk all seven questions at examination pace in the full practice run.
